manifest.name: gdn-fp8-unsloth-mlp0-27-q4k-mlp46-63-lmhead
manifest.description: FP8 on every recurrent projection, with the MLP split by what each part fixes: the attested calibrated NVFP4 bytes (unsloth) on MLP layers 0-27, where they cut maths drift without touching prefill, and Q4_K fitted from BF16 on MLP layers 46-63 only, which lowers code, general and tools drift while costing far less prefill than Q4_K on the whole MLP. MLP layers 28-45 keep the shipped bytes: Q4_K there cancels the maths gain. Attention keeps the shipped bytes (a mixed-format attention stack loses long context); lm_head is stored BF16 so its batch-1 Q4_K is fitted once from the original weights.
